name: certs.here
summary: A certificate register and verification service. Training providers issue new certificates or import old ones (including from a retired Moodle site) and each gets a link that works without the original learning platform; learners keep awards from several providers in a private wallet.

value: Keeping past course certificates checkable after a Moodle site closes
Issuing and verifying course completion certificates
Letting employers check an award without signing in
Import past awards from a CSV file
Certificate design and individual or bulk issuing
Expiry dates, corrections and withdrawal at the same link
Private learner wallet across providers, sharing one certificate at a time
Public verification page showing issuer, issue date and status
Verified issuer domain and verified organisation badges

value.from: Free for the first 1,000 certificates; then £12 a year up to 10,000
value.notes: Published tiers (GBP, per year): up to 1,000 free; 1,001–10,000 £12; 10,001–100,000 £49; unlimited £200. Issued and imported certificates count once across all courses and years. The terms call these proposed prices: a paid plan needs a separate agreement on price, billing and cancellation.

Web server and primary database hosted by netcup GmbH in Nuremberg, Germany; administered from the UK. Microsoft 365 handles email and backups (last 30 nightly backups in OneDrive). The issuer controls learner records.

researchTasks: Standards: no Open Badges, W3C Verifiable Credentials, LTI or API claims on the site (24 Nov 2026). Asked the vendor; record the answer in `standards`.

Continuity: the terms say 'We do not promise uninterrupted access or a fixed lifetime for a link'; links stay checkable for the retention period an issuer chooses, and closing an account offers a secure export or deletion. Ask what export format is used.
Read /data-processing (provider list), /help and /moodle-certificate-archive, not opened on 24 Nov 2026.
Geographic availability is our reading of the terms (English law, UK company); confirm whether it serves issuers outside the UK.
Hands-on test planned with a free issuer account (vendor's suggested workflow: issue, verify signed out, withdraw, re-check, CSV import).

dataGaps.note: None claimed on the vendor's pages; asked.
